name: SM_Boulder_Red_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: angular reddish-brown boulder, 1.5 x 1.1 x 0.7 m, visibly cracked (the bombable rock of the game)
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: A sphere cut by random break planes and gently displaced: edges are soft, with no undercuts, overhangs or split-off slabs, and the base is a flat clip rather than a buried foot with soil piled against it. One rock scan, box projected and tinted, carries all surface detail; its features do not follow the displaced form. Moss and lichen are procedural masks. Deep cracks are modelled because the scripted (bombable) red rocks must look cracked; the main crack reads a little like a seam, and an intact variant is not built.
